name: dsh-remote-server
description: Self-hostable public relay node for DeepSeek Harness remote control

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=20000 test/discovery.test.ts test/hosts.test.ts test/pairing.test.ts test/assets.test.ts test/security.test.ts test/tunnel.test.ts
